messages:
kai: Quick ask — ACME legal signed a clause requiring a per-customer opt-out for batching/quantization for a subset of enterprise seats. Need to gate by contract entitlement + tenant tag. Who owns flag config and rollout plan? @amalie @sasha
amalie: I can own the flag and QA. We should keep it tenant-scoped and only target explicit entitlements, not entire account groups. Can we get a list of tenant IDs from sales?
sasha: Sales sent a CSV earlier, attaching link: <https://redwood.internal/sales/ACME_entitlements.csv>. We'll need to ensure tokens/data lineage kept private.
kai: thanks. Proposal: create flag feature.customer_conformance.acme_exempt with shotgun config:
```
rule: tenant_entitlement == 'acme_enterprise_v2'
action: disable_quantization, disable_batching
scope: tenant
stage: canary
canary_percent: 1
rollback_on_error: true
```
priyanka: prefer using entitlement id instead of string match. Also add circuit-breaker: if error_rate > 1% for 5m rollback to default.
sasha: agree. Also add audit log hook + restrict who can flip (eng-platform+security groups). Can deploy to canary 1% tomorrow ~10:00PT?
amalie: I'll open PR for flag schema + playbook. Ping me for review @kai @sasha
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: feature-flag-service/flags#acme_exempt -> canary (1%) at 2026-03-18T17:00Z
kai: timeline sounds good. Checklist: 1) PR + review 2) sales confirm tenant list 3) add abort metric 4) ops playbook. I'll update runbook.
priyanka: quick Q — do we need data residency change for those tenants? legal asked.
amalie: Not unless they request it; note for sales/solutions. I'll put a note in the PR.
kai: Perfect. If no objections I'll mark this ready for canary tomorrow. :thumbsup:
